name: Class Action Defender

shapes: clause1: continuous self damage-shield — while in play, any damage instance to source with amount > 4 is reduced to 0 (needs conditional-damage-prevention: DamageModifierDefinition {selector:{isCard:source}, minAmount:5, setTo:0})
clause2: triggered event:'battleStarted' + condition battleRole:'defender' -> mayPay {player:'controller', costs:[payResources 2], effects:[restore {target:source}]}

proposedCapabilities.kind: effects.ts DamageModifierDefinition extension + engine pre-inflict damage pass (SpoilsEngine.damageDeltaFor / inflictLockedBattleDamage)
proposedCapabilities.spec: Add optional `minAmount?: NumberExpression` and `setTo?: NumberExpression` (default 0) to DamageModifierDefinition. In the same pre-inflict pass that already sums `delta` (runs before checkStateBasedActions), after flat `delta` is applied, if `minAmount` is set and the resulting incoming amount to a card matching `selector` (and `sourceSelector`/`battleOnly` if given) is >= minAmount, clamp the amount inflicted to `setTo`. Standing/permanent, re-evaluated per damage instance, no pre-registration or expiry. Class Action Defender: {selector:{isCard:source}, minAmount:5, setTo:0} ('greater than 4' => >=5 for integer damage; 'reduce it to 0').
proposedCapabilities.why: 'When any amount of damage greater than 4 is inflicted to this card, reduce it to 0' is a passive amount-thresholded shield that must act BEFORE the hit lands. preventDamage{wholeInstance} is a one-shot pre-registered shield (Visible Loaf), not a standing trait. damageModifiers.delta is flat-additive and its NumberExpression context has no access to the incoming amount (eventDamageAmount resolves to 0 inside damageDeltaFor). A post-damage damageDealt-triggered heal fails because checkStateBasedActions runs inside the battle-damage event batch (SpoilsEngine ~L8667) BEFORE queued damageDealt triggers process, and every >4 hit exceeds this card's 3 life, so it is destroyed before any heal resolves.

notes: Clause 1 needs pre-inflict prevention (see proposedCapabilities); a triggered heal cannot save it (SBA-before-trigger ordering in the battle-damage batch, CR 408.4 / RULES.md 11). Clause 2 is the documented 'when you are attacked, you may pay' pattern (battleStarted + battleRole defender -> mayPay).

notes: 'discards a card at random' = randomFromSelection over opp hand -> moveCard discard; then mill 2.

name: Poisoned Blade

shapes: continuous ability grantedAbilities: [{selector matches attachedTo, abilities:[{triggered event:'damageDealt', condition and(sourceIsDamageSource, cardTypeIs {target:'eventCard', cardType:'character'}), effects:[destroy {target:'eventCard'}]}]}]

activated 'HANDOFF': costs [deplete {selected 'newWearer'}]; targets [{selector:{controller:'self', type:'character', conditions:[not {inBattle {selected __candidate}}]}, count:1, id:'newWearer'}]; effects [attachTo {target:source, to:{selected 'newWearer'}}]

notes: 'When the attached character inflicts damage to a character' = grant trigger to host (Form 37-Ohhhhh pattern). HANDOFF cost is deplete-only (no pay). eventCard for damageDealt = the damaged character -> destroy it.

name: Recreant Cad

shapes: activated 'SNEAK': condition numberCompare({count {owner:'opponent', zone:'discard'}}, '>=', 10); costs [payResources 1, removeFromGame (2 cards, selector:{owner:'opponent', zone:'discard'})]; effects [grantKeyword {target:source, keyword:'covert', duration:untilEndOfTurn}]

notes: 'at least 10 cards in their discard' = ActivatedAbility.condition; 'Remove 2 cards in that player's discard from the game' = removeFromGame cost (Cad's controller chooses which 2).

name: Throatstabber

shapes: triggered cardEnteredPlay + sourceIsEventCard -> flipCoin {winEffects:[], loseEffects:[deplete {target:source}]}

notes: Brief: Throatstabber should use flipCoin for consistency.

name: Two-Headed Coin

shapes: ReplacementAbility replaces:{event:'coinFlip', result:'lose'}, optional:true, optionalCost:[moveSelected {target:source, to:'deck', shuffle:true}], effects:[<reflip the coin, use that result>, draw {player:'controller', amount:1}]

notes: Brief: Two-Headed Coin NEEDS the coin-flip replacement hook (replaces:{event:'coinFlip', result:'lose'}). 'Shuffle this card into its owner's deck' is the optional cost; reflip + draw are the replacement effects.

name: Unexpected Boobysnake

shapes: static keyword: tactical

triggered cardEnteredPlay + condition and(sourceIsEventCard, not isActivePlayer) -> chooserSelectsOption {chooser:'controller', options:[{label:'Discard a card', effects:[chooserSelectsTarget {chooser:'controller', declaration:{selector:{controller:'self', zone:'hand'}, count:1}} -> moveCard {selected -> discard}]}, {label:'Destroy this card', effects:[destroy {target:source}]}]}

notes: TACTICAL keyword. 'if you deployed it during an opponent's turn' = not isActivePlayer at ETB resolution. 'discard a card or destroy this card' = player's choice (chooserSelectsOption).

name: Wild Boars

shapes: continuous ability blockRestriction: {minBlockerSpeed:{stat source speed}, condition: and(inBattle {target:source, role:'attacker'}, numberCompare({count {type:'character', conditions:[inBattle {selected __candidate} role:'attacker']}}, '=', 1))}

notes: Named example for block-eligibility-restriction ('only characters with at least X speed can block it, X = its speed'). 'Sole member of an attacking party' via count(attackers) == 1 (or battlePartySize ownParty == 1).
